history.overview: The Citadel Complex is the operational heart of Muramite power in Kuua.

timeline.name: Citadel Construction
timeline.description: Muramite forces constructed the Citadel and its surrounding complex.

timeline.name: Warfront Integration
timeline.description: The complex became the central hub for warfront coordination.

timeline.name: Discord Saturation
timeline.description: Discord energy saturated the region, empowering Muramite operations.

timeline.name: Resistance Attempts
timeline.description: Rare resistance operations attempted infiltration of the complex.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Citadel Complex remains the most secure Muramite stronghold in Kuua.
